params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within a short time of damaging them {{sti|cdr|reduces}} the '''current''' cooldowns of {{cis|Katarina}} {{tip|abilities}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Sinister Steel:}} Whenever '''Katarina''' retrieves a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, she uses it to slash around herself, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, as well as {{sti|cdr|reducing}}  ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina|Shunpo's}}'' '''total''' cooldown.
params.blurb3: A {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} will disappear after being on the ground for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reduce the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Katarina's''' {{tip|abilities}} by 15 seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Sinister Steel:}} Whenever '''Katarina''' retrieves a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, she slashes around herself to deal {{pplevel|68;72;77;82;89;96;103;112;121;131;142;154;166;180;194;208;224;240;257;275<!--|formula=???-->|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|key=%|70 to 100 for 4|1 to 16}} AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects to enemy champions hit, and reduce ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina|Shunpo's}}'' '''current''' cooldown by {{pp|key=%|78 to 96 for 4|1 to 16}} of its '''total''' cooldown.
params.description4: {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} grant {{tip|sight}} of their radius and will disappear after being on the ground for 4 seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Voracity's'' cooldown reduction will still take effect even after '''Katarina''' dies.
* The {{as|Dagger's|buzzword}} area of effect indicator is displayed even before it lands, although '''Katarina''' may not slash until it has. This can be targeted by {{ai|Shunpo|Katarina}}.
* {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if {{tip|dodged}}. They cannot be {{tip|block|blocked}} nor can they be missed while '''Katarina''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* Single-use on-hit effects, such as {{tip|Spellblade}}, will apply to the closest target to '''Katarina''' when she uses a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Katarina}} throws a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} at the target enemy that can bounce to up to two additional nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: The {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} then lands onto the ground near where it struck the first target.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' throws a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. Upon arrival, the {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} also bounces to up to two additional {{tip|sight|visible}} nearby enemies, dealing the same damage and travelling to bounce targets over {{fd|0.15}} seconds each time.
params.description2: The {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} lands {{rutngt|1}} after striking the first target, {{tt|about 350 units|slightly random location}} opposite from their position when it struck them.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Katarina}} briefly gains {{tip|ghosting}} and a burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}}, tossing a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} into the air directly above herself.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' tosses a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} into the air above her current location and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays until it lands after {{fd|1.25}} seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} for the same duration.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Katarina}} {{tip|blinks}} to the target location around the target unit or {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the nearest enemy and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' {{tip|blinks}} to a target location near the unit or {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} closest to the cursor, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the nearest enemy in range and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
params.description2: '''Katarina''' prioritizes blinking to the location near {{as|Daggers|buzzword}}, then enemy champions, then enemy non-champions, and then any other unit.
params.notes:
* ''Shunpo's'' effects occur before the cast time.
* ''Shunpo'' does not reset '''Katarina's''' basic attack timer if it killed the target.{{bug|2}}
* ''Shunpo'' can be used on any unit except {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
* ''Shunpo'' can be cast on {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} that haven't landed yet.
* ''Shunpo'' prioritizes damaging enemy champions within range at the targeted location.
* After the cast time, '''Katarina''' will attempt to move towards the closest enemy in {{tip|acquisition radius|acquisition range}} and basic attack them, prioritizing champions, unless an attack command was already active on another target in range or any attack command was applied during the cast time. Movement commands applied during cast time will override the automatic attack, but they may not override an already active manually applied attack command. If no enemy is in range, pre-cast commands will remain active, and attack commands applied during the cast time will be ignored {{bug|2}}.
** If a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} is picked during the cast time, pre-cast commands will be cancelled, even if no enemy is nearby. And if an enemy is nearby, '''Katarina''' may or may not start an automatic attack {{bug|2}}.
* If the target is very close to a wall and '''Katarina''' targets ''Shunpo'' behind the target, she can blink over the wall.
* ''Shunpo'' will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if {{tip|dodged}}. It cannot be {{tip|block|blocked}} nor can it be missed while '''Katarina''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* ''Shunpo'' does not require the enemy to be within targeting range to damage them. It only requires them to be within the max range around a unit that ''Shunpo'' allows them to blink to.
{{ct|cast}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Katarina}} {{tip|channel|channels}} for a short time, rapidly throwing a flurry of daggers to up to 3 of the closest nearby enemy champions.
params.blurb2: Each dagger deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}}, applies {{tip|on-attack}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and inflicts {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} on the target.
params.blurb4: ''A nearby enemy champion is required to cast this ability.''
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, rapidly throwing a dagger every {{fd|0.166}} seconds to up to 3 of the closest nearby enemy champions, {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself in the process.

Each dagger deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced in effectiveness, and inflicts {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} on the target for 3 seconds.
params.description2: ''An enemy champion within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 500 units is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
params.notes:
* An alternate form of writing the formula for the '''bonus AD''' ratio (and which the game data is using internally) is {{as|(16%{{times}}(1 {{as|+ {{fd|312.5}}% per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed}}) '''bonus''' AD)}}.
** At level 6, '''Katarina''' has a minimum of {{fd|10.82}}% '''bonus''' attack speed.
*** The minimum physical damage per dagger is {{as|{{ap|16*(1+(10.82/100)*3.125)}}% '''bonus''' AD}}.
* In ''addition'' to already revealing herself, '''Katarina''' will {{tip|sight|reveal}} her location (400 radius) for {{fd|4.5}} seconds every time she throws a dagger at an enemy while the enemy team does not otherwise have vision of her.{{bug}}
** Because of this, the vision on '''Katarina's''' location will persist for up-to {{fd|4.5}} seconds after the channel ends.
* ''Death Lotus'' will not end if no enemies remain in range.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block and be consumed by only one dagger.
* Each dagger counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Conqueror}}, {{ri|Electrocute}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
* The on-attack modifier also incorrectly applies to various other damaging effects triggered by the same damage instance, including {{ri|Hail of Blades}}{{tt|*|if previously activated by attacking}}, {{ri|Scorch}}, {{ii|Blackfire Torch}}, {{ii|Hextech Alternator}}, {{ii|Liandry's Torment}}, {{ii|Luden's Echo}}, {{ii|Scout's Slingshot}}.{{bug}}
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Katarina''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** Trying to cast a disabled active (excluding {{ii|Hextech Rocketbelt}}) will buffer it to cast at the completion of the channel.

params.tips: * The ability will light up once an enemy champions gets into range, even if not {{tip|sight|visible}}, revealing they're nearby.
